name: SigLIP base (image search and understanding)
summary: The model behind Atlas’s “describe what you are looking for” search, families and taste.
details: A vision-language model that places pictures and words in the same space. Atlas uses it on this computer to find pictures from a description, group them into named families, tell finished artwork from technical images and learn your taste. It does not write descriptions; it measures how well words and pictures match. It runs on the graphics card through DirectML or on the processor, and everything stays on this computer.
